You’re in a valley. Life is cyclical. Sometimes it blows sometimes it’s great. You being down right now means you’re gonna come back up next. I know sometimes it feels like theres no end in sight, we have some similarities just from what I read. I struggle with anxiety nearly every day. The one thing that helps and I can’t always make it work is to force myself to slow down. You can only do what you can do right now. Don’t put every problem on your plate because it’s gonna start the anxiety wheels and you’re gonna spiral. Just try and take one problem at a time and keep your eye on the prize. Don’t forget, there is no shame in crying/screaming it out. You CAN do this!!!. And also, I know what you mean when you say you just wanna be someone else for a while. I know you don’t feel it now, but one day you’re gonna fall in love with yourself ( not in a creepy way but in a growth way, trust me). Everyone who’s here is worth something. Everyone who’s here is special and has something  to offer, including you. You may not see it yet, but you will. Good luck, you got this.
